heading: Technical expertise
sub: A cross-disciplinary stack spanning AI engineering and field marine science.

built.title: Coral reef tipping points
built.desc: A coral–seaweed–herbivore model built on synthetic data to test reef-resilience methods — tipping points, recovery zones, early-warning signals and management scenarios. Run it in your browser.

built.title: EcoQuad
built.desc: Upload a quadrat photograph, get grid-based percentage cover for macroalgae and sessile invertebrates.

built.title: marineAnnotate
built.desc: Annotation for marine biologists that keeps the imagery local — label detections and habitat classes without sending sensitive survey data anywhere.

built.title: Species detectors
built.desc: YOLO-based detectors for macroalgae, fish and seagrass, plus ensemble pipelines under evaluation for BioBoost+ WP1.
